notes.title: [Notice on Bugs Fix]
notes.content:
Hello, this is Sesisoft.

Thank you for your interest and support in The Cloud Dream of the Nine Steam version.
We announce that some of the bugs and points of improvements from users were applied through the patch below.
Please, check the patch details below.
Thank you.


[How to apply patch]
For those who have installed the game before, please end the game and proceed with the "update" in the library.
If the "Update" button does not appear, you can check it by logging out and logging in again.


[Patch Details]
★ The issue that the last chapter of Chaeyoon's route in <One girl's love story> is not able to proceed has been fixed.

notes.title: [Notice on Bugs Fix]
notes.content:
Hello, this is Sesisoft.

Thank you for your interest and support in The Cloud Dream of the Nine Steam version.
We announce that some of the bugs and points of improvements from users were applied through the patch below.
Please, check the patch details below.
Thank you.

[How to apply patch]
For those who have installed the game before, please end the game and proceed with the "update" in the library.
If the "Update" button does not appear, you can check it by logging out and logging in again.

[Patch Details]

★ We have corrected the issue that occurs when a particular language user selects an English option.

★ We have corrected the issue that the automatic skip function doesn't work when there're effects coming out.

★ I corrected the problem that the line appears to be pushed back in the replay.

★ We corrected some typos in the game.

★ Through Steam Cloud Support, players can play the game in other PCs with the same save file.

★ The automatic scroll of lyrics has been improved to be able to switch on/off when listening to songs.

★ The delay time has decreased slightly when changing the screen.

★ The sound quality of some songs has been improved.

★ The AI manager function will be temporarily suspended to improve the quality of conversation services.

notes.title: Patch Notice on Issue Fix
notes.content:
Hello, this is Sesisoft.

Thank you for your interest and support in The Cloud Dream of the Nine Steam version.

We are carefully referencing the bug reports and points of improvements sent by users immediately after launch for the official launch.

We announce that there's an important issue that users cannot proceed the game and it is now fixed through the patch.

For those who have installed the game before, please end the game and proceed with the "update" in the library.
If the "Update" button does not appear, you can check it by logging out and logging in again.

Thank you.

[b][Patch Details][/b]

* The issue of not proceeding the scenario after the female character's monologue scene after the dialogue below.
Baeknan - I'll see you later!
Truguy - Ok! See you later!
Wol - I see what happened. Should we go back first?
